title: Fix Tauri launcher Python preflight
summary: Repair the local Tauri shell launch failure by restoring bundled Python runtime dependencies, refreshing the desktop shortcut metadata, and hardening the Tauri launcher Python preflight diagnostics/candidate selection.
reason: The promoted desktop shortcut reached the canonical Tauri launcher, but the launcher selected the first bundled Python runtime even when it could not import the backend after the package-layout migration. The hidden Python traceback was ModuleNotFoundError for pydantic, so the shortcut appeared to crash after only a few launcher lines.
behavior_before: The Tauri launcher selected apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe as soon as the file existed, then failed its local API module preflight with a generic 'python -m mediapipeline.desktop.local_api_main --help failed' exception when pydantic was missing. The desktop shortcut also still used an ops working directory and a stale DesktopApp/tauri_shell icon path.
behavior_after: Both ignored bundled Python runtimes include the declared runtime dependencies needed for local API import. The Tauri launcher now validates Python candidates with the local API help preflight before selecting one and reports candidate-specific traceback detail if none are usable. The desktop shortcut points at the canonical launcher, repo-root working directory, and active apps/desktop/tauri icon.
manual_validation: cmd /d /c ops\\scripts\\dev\\start-tauri-preview.bat -CheckOnly - passed; launcher selected apps\\desktop\\runtime\\Python\\python.exe after runtime dependency repair and verified local API module import

pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps\\desktop\\tauri\\Test-TauriShell-Launch.ps1 -Mode Dev -TimeoutSeconds 90 -CloseTimeoutSeconds 25 - passed; detected Tauri PID 17852 and backend PID 29312, closed shell, and confirmed cleanup
rollback_plan: Revert apps/desktop/tauri/Launch-MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO-TauriPreview.ps1 to its previous Python resolution behavior, remove the ignored runtime dependency installs if necessary, and restore the previous desktop shortcut metadata. Then rerun start-tauri-preview.bat -CheckOnly to confirm the prior failure mode is restored.
notes:
Installed pydantic>=2,<3 and psutil>=5.9,<8 into ignored bundled Python runtimes under apps/desktop/runtime/Python and ops/pipeline/runtime/Python so local shortcut launch can import mediapipeline.desktop.local_api_main.
Updated C:/Users/lmmye/OneDrive/Desktop/MediaPipeline V6.lnk outside the repository: TargetPath remains ops/scripts/dev/start-tauri-preview.bat, WorkingDirectory is now the repo root, and IconLocation now uses apps/desktop/tauri/src-tauri/icons/launcher-logo.ico.
